comments.author: QDkivish
comments.body_html:
From my understanding, tarkov loose loot spawn is basically:

Chance of anything spawn here: xx%

Chance of ‘anything’ being xxx: xx%

This mod sets the first chance to 100 while setting the second chance to equal for every item in the loot pool of this point.

If a loot point only has intelligence folder and LEDX in its loots pool then the chance to get either is 50/50, but if the only thing in its loot pool is intelligence folder then yes you will get ‘constantly the same’ loot in this particular point.

comments.author: Radicon111
comments.body_html: The syntax for version number in “package.json” is changed in 3.9.0 onward. It’s now “sptVersion”: “~3.x”, - when it USED TO BE “akiVersion”: “~3.x”, - where x is the current version - ie. it’ll be “~3.9” for 3.9.3 etc. That’s how to get rid of the version missing error - but I don’t know if the mod itself will still then work - probably not, because I think various objects have changed in 3.9.0 onward.
